g.text: The drawing is a plan, but the thing that decides it is vertical: how fast water leaves the soil.
The reserve area is drawn and kept empty — a field is a consumable, and the next one needs somewhere to go.
Every outlet of the distribution box sits at the same height, or one trench takes the whole flow.
Sizes, soils and setbacks are fictional; local health codes decide them.
how fast the soil takes water
one trench takes it all and fails
